prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high for unsuccessful tests, but underestimated the gains of winning tests.
Specific layout redesigns (grid view pet companion, centered sign-in, two-column path choice) were helpful, though other redesigns showed no clear effect or performed worse.
Adding new onboarding screens (such as quality validation or personality selection) consistently performed worse.
Reordering onboarding flow performed worse (narrative-first) or showed no clear effect (defer sign-in).
Most copy changes showed no clear effect, except for clear re-authentication sign-in copy which was helpful.
Adding hints, shortcut guides, wait info, notifications, or status banners showed no clear effect.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: +2.1% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: -14.7% over 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +6.9% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +3.0% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +3.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +10.1% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: -3.9% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: +4.5% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: -4.3% over 2 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -1.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: +1.8% over 1 test(s)
- home, redesign: -7.5% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +1.7% over 4 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +4.8% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: -2.3% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: +5.8% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +1.4% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 82.9%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 78.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 73.1%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 25.0%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Compact Layout Pet Companion Selection: Rebuilds the pet selection screen with a compact grid layout, displaying pet options in an efficient side-by-side view. (why: Adoption has a 73.1% conversion rate and a median duration of 89s. A compact layout allows users to quickly compare options without excessive scrolling.)
1: [finish, redesign] Grid Layout Finish Onboarding Summary: Transforms the final onboarding welcome screen into a structured grid layout summarizing key app features. (why: The finish step sees a high drop-off rate (64.8% completion, 395s median time) and user confusion regarding desktop features.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Mascot Setup Screen: Adds a dedicated onboarding step presenting a desktop mascot preview component before entering the home state. (why: Multiple support emails mention pets failing to display on the desktop or users not knowing how to launch them after onboarding.)
3: [home, wait_info] Animated Mascot Generation Progress Indicator: Adds an animated mascot component to the waiting screen while pet generation finishes in the background. (why: The waiting stage takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s). Visual animation reassures users that progress is occurring.)

scores.note: Grid pet companion redesign directly aligns with previous winning tests (+6.9%).
Targets highest drop-off step, but general redesigns on finish step historically underperformed (-1.6%).
Strong funnel and support evidence, but adding new screens consistently harms conversion (-14.7%).
Wait info modifications show no clear strong effect historically (+1.7% across 4 tests).
